comment: Independent witness for restore.c dorecover() reaching region.c rest_regions() and remove_region() on the hero's level. The Valkyrie reads a stinking-cloud scroll and saves on the turn after run_regions() brought the visible cloud's ttl to 0, so the restore removes it without its expire callback and remove_region() tests vision.c does_block() on the restored map.
